sites.remarks: Elevated mountain living begins at 1240 Hawks Nest Lane, where sweeping views, unforgettable sunsets and thoughtful design create an exceptional home in one of Gypsum's most convenient locations. Natural light fills the open-concept main level, connecting the kitchen, dining and living spaces with an effortless flow. A private first-floor bedroom with its own en-suite bathroom creates the perfect mother-in-law suite or refined guest retreat, while a separate half bath serves the main living area. Upstairs, the primary suite becomes a private mountain retreat with beautiful views, multiple closets and a luxurious Euro-style shower. The adjoining flex space offers room for a sophisticated home office, fitness studio, media lounge or second living area. Generous kitchen storage and additional crawl-space attic areas ensure everything has its place. Solar powers the home, while air conditioning and forced-air heating provide dependable comfort through every Eagle County season. The large two-car garage delivers the space local buyers want for vehicles, skis, bikes, snowmobiles, tools and all the gear that comes with mountain living. Outside, the fenced yard and established garden create a private setting for entertaining, relaxing and watching the Colorado sky come alive at sunset. Trails, parks, schools, the Gypsum Recreation Center, Eagle County Regional Airport, local dining and I-70 access are all just minutes away. Offered under $750,000, this is a rare combination of luxury, flexibility, efficiency, storage and location, designed for the way Eagle County is meant to be lived.

sites.remarks: Multifamily development opportunity on 1.49 acres in Steamboat Springs - one of the last available opportunities within Steamboat Springs city limits! Zoned MF-3 the property may offer significant potential for a larger multifamily project. With no HOA, access to the free Steamboat bus route, direct connection to the trail system, all utility infrastructure already in place, and ideally positioned near the ski area, this opportunity offers a prime location for a development. Established and successful apartment rental complex next door makes the location conforming and suitable. Existing duplex dwelling could be incorporated in future development and provides flexibility for a buyer who is not ready to develop immediately, including the option to use the property as a long-term rental while planning a future project all while taking advantage of the lower residential tax rate. 1382 Skyview Lane is fully finished with 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, approximately 1,500 square feet and a 2-car garage and 1384 Skyview Lane offers approximately 2,500 square feet with 3 bedrooms plus a mother-in-law suite, 3 baths, an oversized deck with excellent views and a 3-car garage. An adjacent approximately 0.34-acre parcel with an existing home is separately available for purchase, creating the potential for an approximately 1.83-acre assemblage. This opportunity offers a unique combination of acreage, existing improvements, location and multi-family zoning!

sites.remarks: Steamboat Airport Industrial Park is ideally located just one mile north of Highway 40 along Elk River Road (County Road 129) with multiple access points. This new subdivision features 27 lots ranging from 0.25 up to 3 acres. Whether you’re looking to expand an existing business, start a new one, or simply build a shop for all your equipment, we have the perfect space for you to build on. This is truly one of the last opportunities in Steamboat Springs to own industrial land. Permitted uses are extensive and flexible, including: live/work, workforce housing, automotive repair/sales/rentals, contractor shops, equipment storage yards, food & beverage processing, heavy equipment repairs/sales, manufacturing of all kinds, office/flex spaces, nurseries, mobile food trucks shops, restaurants & tasting/tap rooms, tech and utility centers, warehouse & storage for your business of toys and many more. This subdivision represents a rare chance to meet Steamboat’s growing demand for commercial and industrial services. See Supplemental Documents for the plat and site plan. Final Plat and construction Drawings have been approved and construction will commence asap spring of 2026 and estimated completion of fall of 2026. Zoning is Industrial.
